detailed_description:
The video is a high-definition cinematic commercial shot with bright, natural lighting and a shallow depth of field.
[Shot 1] The video begins exactly as the composition in <Picture 1>, showing <Subject 1> holding a red lipstick tube over a dark marble sink. The sunlight streams from the side, creating sharp highlights on the chrome faucet in the background and the metallic gold band of the lipstick.
[Shot 2] At 00:00.000, the hands of <Subject 1> gently twist the base of the lipstick, causing the red bullet to extend upward from the tube. The hand then slowly rotates the lipstick 30 degrees, allowing the surface of the red pigment to catch the sunlight and reveal its creamy texture. The camera performs a gradual push-in with small amplitude, focusing tighter on the shimmering lipstick bullet as it moves. The background remains softly blurred, keeping the focus on the product.

overall_soundscape:
The mechanical click and soft scrape of the lipstick tube twisting, accompanied by the subtle friction of fingertips against the plastic and metal casing.
